root_causes: Same-size outer frames exposed new child layout before native placement and completed XSync too early.
Extent changes omitted CWWidth/CWHeight; the WM retained old body sizes and fed them back to Win32.
fix: Preparing a target-size composition updates its resize background without publishing an immediate copy.
Native resize uses prepared pixels; same-size frames wait for layout acknowledgement and final copy.
Changed GTK extents include an explicit width and height request even when outer dimensions match.
